_what_this_is: Decisions the Lead owns that no gate row can express. A gate row measures something about the build; these measure nothing at all, so nothing turns red or green when they are answered. That is why they live here instead of in the gate.
_why_a_queue_and_not_a_list_of_asks: Before this file these decisions lived in a session handoff. A fresh chat could not see them, nothing ranked them against each other, and nothing recorded that an answer had arrived - which is a stop, not a queue.
_how_to_use: Answer by setting `state` to "answered" and writing the answer in `answer`. A test enforces that an answered entry carries an answer, so a decision cannot be ticked off without one. Set `state` to "deferred" only when the answer is a real "not now" - deferred is not answered, and the gate keeps listing it so it is not forgotten.
_validation: Content/Python/polish_readiness.py::queue_problems checks every field below and the gate prints any problem in a "The queue is not trustworthy" section. It is validated strictly because a queue that can look answered without carrying an answer is worse than no queue: it reports a ruling that never happened.
_not_here: Gate rows with a `decide` action are already in POLISH_READINESS.md under each gate's "What to do" table. Only decisions with no row behind them belong here.

decisions.question: Should the gate be allowed a severity ladder, so a row can be WARN as well as RED?
decisions.recommendation: No. Keep master_binding and family_distinct hard RED. The capability is already recorded in Docs/38_AI_AGENT_PRACTICE.md 11.3 and is deliberately not applied, because adding WARN and marking those two rows WARN would quietly undo the 2026-10-04 ruling that they stay RED.
options: No - keep only RED, and keep those two rows RED (recommended)
Yes - add WARN, and re-render master_binding and family_distinct as WARN
blocks: nothing today - the gate is correct as it stands; this decides whether a future row may be soft

decisions.question: Is "polish" the right name for this stage, given the build is at a vertical slice and not at alpha?
decisions.recommendation: Decide before the name does damage rather than after. Industry usage defines polish as the alpha to beta transition, and this build has no human playtest record, so calling pre-production work "polish" sets an expectation the build cannot meet. Renaming is mechanical once you say so, and touches every gate row id, both Docs/qa/POLISH_* files and four canon docs.
options: Rename now, before more docs accumulate the word
Keep the name and record that it is known-wrong (current state)
Rename, but keep POLISH_* paths and only change prose
blocks: prose accuracy in Docs/qa/POLISH_READINESS.md and POLISH_BASELINE.json
nothing executable - every gate row id keeps working under either name

decisions.question: Does tutor mode belong in canon as a third working state alongside working and asking?
decisions.recommendation: The capability now exists in this file's sibling fields - action_kind separates "labour only you can do" from "a judgment only you can make" - so the mechanism is built. What is not decided is whether to name it a mode in canon and where its procedures live. That is yours to call, and it is a taste-and-vocabulary question rather than an engineering one.
options: Yes - add a canon row and a Docs/human-use/ page for it
No - keep it as gate machinery only, not a named mode
Yes, but after the polish pass, not now
blocks: a canon row in Docs/38_AI_AGENT_PRACTICE.md describing the third state
whether procedures like the eight-verb script get their own Docs/human-use/ page

decisions.question: Build the idea-to-Early-Access pipeline map, one owner per step, indexed on Docs/CANON_MAP.md?
decisions.recommendation: Largest remaining gap against the vision, but not worth building while Early Access is paused - a pipeline map with no destination describes a journey nobody is taking.
options: Defer until Early Access is active again (chosen 2026-10-04)
decisions.deferral_reason: Lead paused Steam Early Access on 2026-10-04 and said to continue the rest of the work. Raised twice before that without an answer; recorded here so it is not lost.
